_ R Q _ P R _ S _ _ Q S P R Q _

options.text: P S Q P R S
P S R Q P S
P R Q S P S

questions.solution:
Given : _ R Q _ P R _ S _ _ Q S P R Q _ 

By checking options :

 
• P Q R S P R → __**P**__ R Q __**Q**__ P R __**R**__ S __**S**__ __**P**__ Q S P R Q __**R**__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern) 
 
• P S Q P R S → __P__ R Q **__S__** P R **__Q__** S **__P__** **__R__** Q S P R Q **__S__** → (It follows the pattern of : PRQS - PRQS - PRQS - PRQS)
 
• P S R Q P S → __P__ R Q **__S__** P R __R__ S **__Q__** __P__ Q S P R Q **__S__** → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• P R Q S P S → __P__ R Q **__R__** P R **__Q__** S __S__ __P__ Q S P R Q **__S__** → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

⇒Option - (2) gives the pattern of "__P__ R Q __S__ - P R __Q__ S - __P__ __R__ Q S - P R Q __S__"

Hence, "**P S Q P R S**" is the correct answer.
